purpose: Record adding the metallo_beta_lactamase mechanism-fingerprint family (49th fingerprint) and sourcing its first reviewed-Swiss-Prot bronze tranche, growing combined labels 8902 -> 8906 (+4) while leaving the frozen current702 benchmark byte-unchanged.
representation_loop_note: MBL shares bc_beta_lactam_hydrolysis with serine_beta_lactamase, but the 150 serine rows dominate the 4 MBL rows, so serine_beta_lactamase self-consistency stays 1.0 and MBL is 0.75; overall LOO 0.718 -> 0.716 (above the 0.70 floor). No per-family assertion change needed.
reviewed_supply_note: Only 4 novel reviewed-Swiss-Prot metallo-beta-lactamases exist beyond the registry under the metallo/zinc + beta-lactam handle (37 fetched, 4 corroborated). MBL is a small family relative to AKR/AAC.
